name: error_429_ip_flood
description: The per-address flood limit (upstream IpRateLimit, before tiering) answers RFC 9457 problem+json too: a `rate-limited` type, Retry-After in seconds, its own RateLimit-* window and no-store. The client maps it exactly like the tier 429.

body.title: Too many requests
body.detail: Per-address request rate exceeded (100 per 1 s). Retry after 1 s.
